notes: Rows come from the paper's generated tables/*.tex files; captions, column headers, column groups and the first row group come from the table environment in the main tex. 'cells[].tex' keeps every cell exactly as in the file; 'cells[].text' is the cell with LaTeX removed.
Wording: the paper's category label 'fake' is shown as 'manipulated' in every text field (row labels, group labels); 15 substitutions were made. The raw 'tex' fields keep the original.
values[] holds the numeric value columns of a row (columns with kind 'value'), as printed (percent where the unit is '%'). A '--' cell is null. bold[] marks the paper's bold cells.
paper_table_number is computed by counting table captions in the source order of the main tex (LaTeX numbering).

caption is the paper's caption with LaTeX removed; caption_site is the caption to show on the site. They are equal except for tab_crossfamily, tab_tier3_main and tab_modes, where caption_note explains a correction, and tab_unmarker, which is not in the paper.

tables.label: tab:crossfamily
tables.caption: Open-set attribution and watermark detection on the 1,193-image synthetic cohort matched by generator, prompt, and seed. The identity attribution block reports open-set attribution accuracy (in @1%FPR) budget, using 100 candidate identities for the 11 post-hoc methods and 1,024 native keys for RingID. The message recovery block reports TPR@1%FPR (%) for seven post-hoc and three in-generation methods, using bit agreement with the known embedded sentence payload as the detection score. Unattacked denotes performance before attack, C1–C4 denote attack categories, and All is the mean over attacked conditions.
tables.caption_tex: Open-set attribution and watermark detection on the 1,193-image synthetic cohort matched by generator, prompt, and seed. The message recovery block reports TPR@1\%FPR (\%) for seven post-hoc and three in-generation methods, using bit agreement with the known embedded sentence payload as the detection score. The wording should be confirmed by the authors.
